g.text: Estimator ppml; target functional theta_var. Bands are projection hulls of an estimated plug-in image; interior attainment is not
established; finite endpoints are inner approximations. tau* in [0.615, 0.625] (unresolved_band). The grid stays below its
certified bounded lower endpoint. Points mark the sampled tolerances and the segments between them are interpolation. The axis is
truncated at tau = 0.538, the last sampled tolerance below the branch switch near tau*; 8 sampled tolerances above it are
computed and reported but not drawn.
